value.rationale: Minimal two-harmonic information, a closed positivity-realization test and an explicit ill-conditioning mechanism address a motivated climate inverse problem: disentangling upper heat capacity, deep storage, coupling and radiative feedback from harmonic response. The one-frequency/zero-frequency obstruction determines a real experiment-design boundary rather than an arbitrary parameter instance. The result does not claim new forward climate physics, model fit to observations, or practical noisy-data calibration.
